The '''Ord Biniir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Biniir/Legends|Ord Biniir]].
